@@ -40,0 +42,7 @@
+
+func getUser(db *sql.DB, name string) (*User, error) {
+	query := "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"
+	row := db.QueryRow(query)
+	var u User
+	err := row.Scan(&u.ID, &u.Name, &u.Email)
+	return &u, err
+}

+	"database/sql"

+func search(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, db *sql.DB) {
+	kw := r.URL.Query().Get("q")
+	q := "SELECT * FROM items WHERE name LIKE '%" + kw + "%'"
+	client := &http.Client{}
+	resp, _ := client.Get("http://example.com/upstream?q=" + kw)
+	log := fmt.Sprintf("searching for %s", kw)
+	fmt.Println(log)

+	rows.Close()
+}
